cases.narrative: He admitted to covering the girl’s mouth multiple times Feb. 27, including smothering her with a pillow. He also admitted to striking her multiple times. She had numerous bruises on her head, sternum, forearm, and jaw, a large burn injury on her knee, a human bite mark on her thigh and was only wearing a diaper, according to police. She was reportedly afraid to take baths because he would hold her head under the water.
